newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL- USA Detergents lower.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL- USA Detergents lower.

text.p: A low volume day on Wall Street left little momentum for after-hours trading on Thursday, with USA Detergents Inc among the few issues moving after the bell, traders said.
USA was trading at 20, down 3/8 from its close, despite a late-afternoon upgrade to buy from hold by Prudential Securities.

High-technology stocks generally fell during regular trading, but leading issues in this sector were not moving much after hours. Intel Corp was trading lightly at 153, down slightly from its Nasdaq close of 153-1/8, but there was not much action elsewhere, traders said.
"It hasn't been heavy at all," one trader said.
America Online Inc reported a second-quarter loss after the close of regular trading, but there was no immediate reaction among after-hour traders.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 34,400, compared to Wednesday's 193,600. Session two volume was 239,229, while Tuesday's volume was 2,839,505.
